reviews.title: REQUEST FOR A REFUND ISSUE
reviews.text:
I would like to provide feedback regarding the automatic payment/deduction through my GCash. I noticed that the payment was deducted immediately from my GCash account, and I was not given enough time or a clear notification before the deduction.

I was charged ₱1, 950 after my 3-day free trial ended, even though I never intended to continue with a paid subscription. I cancelled the subscription on the same day I noticed the amount had been deducted from my wallet.

I immediately submitted a refund request, but unfortunately, it was denied. I’m hoping WPS can reconsider my case because ₱1,950 is not a small amount for me. I worked hard for that money and, as someone who values every centavo I earn, it’s really upsetting to lose that much because of an automatic renewal I wasn’t aware of.

I sincerely hope WPS can understand my situation and review my refund request again. I also hope this issue can be improved so other users won’t experience the same thing. Every amount matters, especially when it comes from someone’s hard-earned money. Thank you.

If they reach out to me and offer some help. And if 
I get my hundreds of files back, I’ll revise this review.
